text:
Nora: Heads-up from today's design walk: bulk edits can produce what we're informally calling a 'priority tangle' 1 multiple rules collapse into the same numeric slot and the editor just stacks them. That confused a PM. Proposal: an inline micro-indicator (tiny pill) that surfaces count + a Resolve shortcut (keyboard-friendly) that opens a slim overlay to fix ordering. Diego: +1 to micro-indicator. Naming nit: 'Conflict' feels heavy. what about 'Tangle (2)' or 'Ordering issue (2)'? Also recommend a keyboard shortcut: when focused on a rule, press Shift+R to open resolve overlay. Josie: Accessibility notes: pill must be focusable (tabindex=0), role=button, and announce via aria-live when it appears. Suggested announce text: "Priority tangle detected between 'Signup - Free' and 'Signup - Paid'". When the overlay opens, set aria-modal=true and trap focus; close on Esc and return focus to the pill. Eli: From simulation side, resolving should be incremental. Overlay actions should call a lightweight route-delta PATCH and the sim runner should re-run only the affected route. No full-sim. Also add a small 'Sim preview' checkbox in the overlay so user can choose to apply changes to the sim immediately or queue them. Lexi: Microcopy ideas: pill label "Tangle (2)"; overlay title "Resolve ordering"; primary CTAs: "Move up" / "Move down" (with keyboard arrow shortcuts hinted), secondary menu for "Merge" and "Pin priority". Tooltip for Merge: "Combine selectors and join actions. Use when both rules should match same traffic." Merge requires typed confirmation. Nora: UX detail: show a compact side-by-side of the rule conditions in the overlay and a tiny match-order preview (numbers 1/2/3). For chained tangles (A/B and B/C) show a small graph icon that opens a 'chain navigator' inside overlay. Diego: Suggest visual affordance: a faint yellow border on rules involved in a tangle and a small chevron drag-handle hint. Also support a batch-resolve: user can select multiple tangled groups and apply the same action. Josie: Add to a11y checklist: aria-describedby on the pill linking to a short text node summarizing the conflict; ensure screen reader reads natural sentence not a fragment. Also ensure toast announcements are accessible (focusable, in the tray). Example snippet for announcer: ```
Priority tangle between "A" and "B". Press Shift+R to resolve.
``` ux-bot: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1725559999-priority-tangle-overlay.png 1 shows pill states, overlay, and chain navigator. Eli: Dev notes: API suggestion PATCH /routes/:route_id/ordering-fix {action: "move_up|move_down|merge|pin", target_rule_id: "uuid", sim_apply: true|false}. Response: {route_delta: "..."} so UI + sim can patch incrementally. We should also expose an endpoint to preview the new match-order without committing: POST /routes/:id/ordering-preview body {proposed_changes: [...] } -> returns preview metrics. Lexi: Copy tests: pluralization for '1 tangle' vs '2 tangles', keyboard hint text consistency, and Merge confirmation language. Nora: Next steps: Josie will add the aria snippets and a short SR script. Eli will spec the incremental sim API and the preview endpoint. Diego & I will prototype the micro-indicator + overlay, add keyboard mnemonics, and demo at next UX sync. Thanks! :sparkles:
